variants.name: 800 g
variants.about_this_item:
• Enriched seed mixture with extruded VAM pellets for canaries
  • Vitamins, amino acids and minerals for optimal condition
  • Optimal intestinal functioning and digestion (Florastimul)
  • Composed in consultation with top European breeders, who use it as the basic food for all their canaries
variants.ingredient_information:
Composition: canary seed, rapeseed, VAM pellets, peeled oats, linseed, big black rapeseed, oyster shells, perilla seed, parsley seed, chia.

Analytical constituents: protein 17%, fat content 13%, crude fibre 6%, crude ash 7%, calcium 1%, phosphorus 0.5%, lysine 0.55%, methionine 0.35%, threonine 0.50%.

Nutritional additives per kg: vitamin A 8800 IU, vitamin D3 1600 IU, vitamin E 20 mg, iron 20 mg, iodine 1.5 mg, copper 7 mg, manganese 48 mg, zinc 45 mg.
variants.feeding_instructions: Provide freely and refresh regularly. Always supply fresh drinking water. Avoid simultaneous oral use with macrolides.
